app.title: HPAC Safety
home.heroSubtitle: HPAC Safety collects and shares incident reports so the hang gliding and paragliding community can learn from what happens in the air.
home.sectionWhy.title: Why report
home.sectionWhy.body: Every report, however small, helps identify patterns before they become serious. Reports can be filed anonymously — signing in only confirms that you are an HPAC member, and your report is never linked to your account — and are reviewed before anything is published.
home.sectionHow.title: How it works
home.sectionHow.body: You describe what happened in your own words. A reviewer checks it, and with your consent, a summary is published to help the wider community.
home.sectionAbout.title: About HPAC
home.sectionAbout.body: The Hang Gliding and Paragliding Association of Canada represents free-flight pilots across the country and promotes safe practice at every level of the sport.
page.placeholder.title: {pageName}
page.placeholder.body: This page is a placeholder. Content for {pageName} is coming soon.
page.report.signInRequiredTitle: Sign in to file a report
page.report.signInRequiredBody: Filing an incident report requires an HPAC member sign-in. Signing in only confirms that you are a member — your report is not linked to your account.
page.report.notTrackedTitle: Your report is not linked to you
page.report.notTrackedBody: Signing in only confirms that you are an HPAC member. We do not record your name, your membership, or any trace of who submitted this report.
report.loadError: The report form could not be loaded. Please reload the page.
report.privacy.localStorage: Your answers are saved in this browser only, for up to 15 days, until you submit. Photos, videos, and documents are never saved in the browser.
report.required.summary: Please answer the following before continuing:
report.attachments.guidance: Attach photos, videos, or documents related to this occurrence, if you have them.
report.attachments.notRestored: Attached files are not saved between visits — if you reload this page, you will need to choose them again.
report.error.network: Your report could not be sent. Your answers are still saved in this browser — please check your connection and try again.
report.error.submitFailed: We could not submit your report. Please try again.
report.submitted.title: Report submitted
report.submitted.body: Thank you. Your report has been received.
page.login.title: Member login
page.login.errorGeneric: We could not sign you in. Check your username and password, then try again.
notFound.title: Page not found

questions.title: Manage questions
questions.intro: The incident form is made of these questions. Editing one creates a new version, and editing one that has already been answered replaces it with a new question, so a report already filed still shows exactly what it was asked.
questions.empty: No questions yet. Add the first one.
questions.dependsOnSummary: Only asked when “{question}” is answered yes
questions.error.unexpected: Something went wrong. Please try again.
questions.field.keyHelp: A short, permanent name used by exports. It never changes once the question is created.
questions.field.privateHelp: A private question's answers help recognise identifying details and never appear in a published summary.
questions.field.dependsOn: Only ask when another question is answered a certain way
questions.field.dependsOnHelp: Only a yes/no or single-select question can enable another one.
questions.field.dependsOnOptionHelp: The reporter must choose this option for the question above before this one is asked.
questions.field.groupedUnder: Display together under a section heading
questions.field.groupedUnderHelp: Only a group question can have other questions displayed under it.
questions.field.optionSetHelp: The choices are copied into this version when it is saved. Editing the shared list later will not change what a reporter was already shown.
questions.field.allowsReporterAdditions: Let a reporter add a choice that is not on the list
questions.field.allowsReporterAdditionsH: A value the list does not offer is added to the shared list and flagged for review, the same way a type-ahead already works.
questions.translate.hint: Write one language, then translate it into the other.
questions.translate.draftWarning: A translation is a draft. Read it and correct it before saving.
questions.translate.unavailable: Translation is not available on this server.
questions.translate.failed: The translation could not be completed. Please try again or write the other language yourself.
questions.translate.standIn: This development server has no translation service, so Translate copies the text across unchanged. Production translates it for real.
choiceLists.title: Manage choice lists
choiceLists.intro: Shared lists of choices that type-ahead and picker questions offer. Saving a list replaces it with exactly what is shown here.
choiceLists.empty: No choice lists yet. Add the first one.
choiceLists.reporterAddedCount: Added by reporters and not yet reviewed: {count}. Check the spelling and the French, and remove anything that should not be offered.
choiceLists.error.unexpected: Something went wrong. Please try again.
choiceLists.field.itemsHelp: A choice left out of this list is retired. Questions that already offered it keep their own copy, so no filed report changes.
answerTranslations.title: Answers awaiting translation
answerTranslations.intro: A reporter answers a picker or a type-ahead in one official language, and nothing translates it on its way in. Supply the other language here; what the reporter wrote is never changed.
answerTranslations.empty: No answers are waiting for a second language.
answerTranslations.error.unexpected: Something went wrong. Please try again.
questions.forkWarning: This question has been answered. Saving retires it and creates a new question in its place, so the answers already given keep the wording they were given under.
questions.import.title: Import from Typeform
questions.import.intro: Upload an English export and its French export as one pair. Nothing is saved until you review and save each question yourself.
questions.import.frenchDefaultedToEnglis: No French text was found for this field, so the English text was used for both languages. Correct the French before saving.
questions.import.rejectedIntro: These fields have no equivalent in the question bank and were skipped.
questions.import.pendingLogicTitle: Branching logic to wire up manually
questions.import.pendingLogicIntro: These fields had conditional logic the importer could not translate automatically. Wire up the equivalent "Depends on" setting by hand, then resolve the note.
questions.import.error.unexpected: Something went wrong. Please try again.
